daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling introspective today, Scorpio. It's a perfect moment to journal your thoughts and trust your gut instincts—they're basically your superpower right now.
daily.love: Your magnetic energy is quietly drawing people in. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your love language today. Let someone see the real you beneath the mysterious exterior.
daily.career: Your focus is sharp and your intuition about workplace dynamics is spot-on. Trust that hunch about a project or collaboration—your insights could genuinely move things forward.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding activities today. Consider a walk, some stretching, or time in nature. Mental clarity follows when you give your nervous system a break from overthinking.

weekly.overview: This week is calling you to lean into your intuition, Scorpio. The cosmic energy is giving introspective vibes mixed with quiet confidence. Trust what you're feeling beneath the surface—your gut knows something your brain hasn't caught up to yet.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a softness in your energy right now. If you're with someone, vulnerability might feel easier than usual. If you're single, pay attention to who's genuinely showing up. Quality over noise, always.
weekly.career: You're picking up on workplace dynamics others are sleeping on. Use that superpower wisely. A conversation or opportunity might feel awkward at first, but it's pushing you toward something aligned with your actual values, not just your resume.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for presence this week. Whether that's meditation, movement, or just putting your phone down for an hour—honor what feels grounding. Listen to what your energy is telling you about rest versus action.
